title: Siege of Fuenterrabía (1638)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Fuenterrabía (1638)", at revision 1370741326, opens: "The siege of Hondarribia of 1638 took place in June – September 1638, between Spain and France during the Thirty Years' War and the Franco-Spanish War (1635-1659)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2888520, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1638 battle of the Franco-Spanish war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
